text: Heat is a quality of touch. It is of various kinds, both eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is atomic in nature; the non-eternal is the product of causes. Furthermore, it is threefold according to the distinction of body, sense organ, and object. The body is well known in the solar realm. The sense organ is the eye, which perceives form and is situated in the black pupil. The object is fourfold, distinguished by terrestrial, divine, internal, and mineral origins. Terrestrial heat is that of fire and the like. Divine heat, which is not produced by friction, is that of lightning and the like. Internal heat is the cause of the transformation of what has been consumed. Mineral heat is that of gold and the like. || 11 ||
